dex.entry: A lily-pad kin that glides on still forest pools. Its broad flat body floats on the surface while long submerged fronds trail below, sensing disturbances. Satisfying mid-form — clearly more capable than a dewdrop yet still serene and a little absurd; slides elegantly on water.

art.silhouette: Flat circular green body like a great lily-pad, smooth emerald top, pale root-fronds hanging down, periscope eyes on short stalks, small trailing flowers at the rim.
